Seller workflow / FIELD GUIDE

The product listing preflight checklist: 12 things to check

Before you hit publish, run through a short list that can prevent expensive surprises later.

By Manglo Editorial6 November 20266 min read
THE MANGLO PLAYBOOK / ORIGINAL GUIDE

Publishing a listing is a series of small decisions. It is easy to overlook a shipping cost, unclear photo or misleading title while trying to finish quickly. Use this checklist before each major listing launch. You can check items off on this page or print it; your selections stay in this browser session and are not sent to Manglo.

Your 12-step preflight

0 of 12 complete

Why these checks belong together

A beautiful photograph cannot fix an incorrect delivery promise. A perfect title cannot rescue an unprofitable order. Treat visual clarity, cost accuracy and buyer expectations as one workflow. Fix the highest-impact mistakes before spending money on traffic.

Make it a repeatable routine

Create a source-photo folder and keep original files. Store your current product dimensions and materials in a simple spreadsheet. Reuse the same preflight process every time, but check marketplace policies again whenever they change. If you work with a team, assign one person to verify figures and another to check the mobile listing.

Starting point for Indian sellers

Before publishing to any marketplace, recheck its current category rules, any required tax information, return terms and image specifications. Those platform-specific rules take priority over this general checklist.

Useful tools for the final pass

Use the image resizer and compressor to prepare photos, then check the numbers in the profit calculator. Every listed tool currently runs without an account.
